# Polite Resignation Email for a Marketing Analyst

A professional, warm resignation note that keeps the relationship positive and gives clear notice of the final date.

## Resignation Email Draft

**Subject:** Resignation - [Your Name]

Dear [Manager’s Name],

Please accept this email as formal notice of my resignation from my role as Marketing Analyst at [Company Name]. My last working day will be **30 June 2026**.

I have valued the opportunity to work with the team over the past three years and appreciate the experience, support, and trust I have received. I am grateful for everything I have learned and for the chance to contribute to the team’s work.

Over the next two weeks, I will do my best to ensure a smooth handover of my current responsibilities, including active campaigns, recurring reporting, and any outstanding priorities. Please let me know how I can help make the transition as seamless as possible.

Thank you again for the opportunity to be part of the team. I hope to stay in touch and wish you and the company continued success.

Kind regards,
[Your Name]

## 2-Week Handover Plan for Active Campaigns and Reports

This plan is built to protect continuity, document recurring work, and leave the team in a strong position before **30 June 2026**.

| Period | Focus | Key Handover Tasks | Deliverable |
|---|---|---|---|
| Days 1-2 | Transition planning | Confirm successor/owner; list all active campaigns; identify report calendar and stakeholders | Handover tracker |
| Days 3-5 | Campaign transfer | Document objectives, budgets, timelines, channels, audiences, and current status for each active campaign | Campaign summary pack |
| Days 6-7 | Reporting documentation | List recurring reports; note data sources, filters, formulas, deadlines, and recipients | Reporting SOPs |
| Days 8-9 | Access and assets | Share file locations, dashboards, naming conventions, and access requirements | Access and asset map |
| Days 10-11 | Stakeholder updates | Brief key contacts on ownership changes; flag any urgent decisions or risks | Stakeholder update log |
| Days 12-13 | Review and QA | Check that all docs are complete; verify links, schedules, and open actions | Final handover review |
| Day 14 | Final closeout | Confirm next steps, answer questions, and hand over remaining items | Final handover sign-off |

## Handover Checklist

- Active campaigns listed with status, priority, deadlines, and owner
- Campaign briefs saved in one shared location
- Performance summaries for each live campaign
- Budget tracker and spend notes updated
- Creative assets, copy, and approval history documented
- Recurring reports listed with:
  - source data
  - refresh schedule
  - formulas/filters
  - delivery recipients
- Dashboard links and login/access notes recorded
- Key contacts and stakeholder preferences documented
- Outstanding risks, blockers, and next actions captured
- Open approvals, vendor tasks, and follow-ups assigned
- Shared folder structure and file naming explained
- Final handover session scheduled with manager or successor

## Final Week Outline

### Monday to Wednesday
- Complete campaign and reporting documentation
- Walk through live dashboards and recurring workflows
- Resolve missing files, links, or access issues

### Thursday
- Hold handover meeting with manager/successor
- Review open actions, deadlines, and escalation points
- Confirm who owns each campaign and report after departure

### Friday
- Send final recap email with links to all handover materials
- Thank teammates and key stakeholders
- Close out remaining tasks and confirm your last-day availability

## Quick Actions

Action: [Button: Copy Email] https://example.com
Action: [Button: Copy Handover Plan] https://example.com

- UK resignation notice guidance: https://www.gov.uk/redundancy-your-rights/notice-periods
- ACAS workplace notice and resignation guidance: https://www.acas.org.uk/your-rights-at-work/notice-periods
